```artifact
Feature: Alarms Management

  Scenario: Controller detects and receives alarms from GUI
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends an alarm with code "ALM001"
    Then the controller should detect the alarm
    And the controller should receive the alarm code "ALM001"

  Scenario: Controller commands the hardware PCB buzzer
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the controller receives an alarm with code "ALM001"
    Then the controller should command the hardware PCB buzzer to sound

  Scenario: GUI/Controller enumerates alarm codes and assigns them priorities
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends an alarm with code "ALM001" and priority "High"
    Then the controller should assign priority "High" to alarm code "ALM001"

  Scenario: GUI displays highest priority alarm on main screen
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends alarms with codes "ALM001" (High) and "ALM002" (Low)
    Then the GUI should display alarm code "ALM001" on the main screen

  Scenario: GUI displays list of active alarms on button press
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends alarms with codes "ALM001" and "ALM002"
    And the user presses the button to display active alarms
    Then the GUI should display a list of active alarms including "ALM001" and "ALM002"

  Scenario: GUI displays alarm on main screen legible at distance of 1 meter
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends an alarm with code "ALM001"
    Then the GUI should display alarm code "ALM001" in a legible font size at a distance of 1 meter

  Scenario: High severity alarms indicated with red color and flashing frequency of 2Hz
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends an alarm with code "ALM001" and severity "High"
    Then the GUI should display alarm code "ALM001" in red color with a flashing frequency of 2Hz

  Scenario: Low severity alarms indicated with yellow color constantly on
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the GUI sends an alarm with code "ALM002" and severity "Low"
    Then the GUI should display alarm code "ALM002" in yellow color that is constantly on
```
